name: Generated
what: Page trees exported from the generator, landing as real editable directories you can modify like any other page.

demos.shows: A generated tree with tabs and nested prose regions

gaps: Cannot see what a full multi-branch tree looks like
No demo of editing an exported tree
blurb: Export a tree, edit it. One seed exported so far.

name: Importance
what: What matters most here, ranked by comparing pairs — humans and bots answer one question repeatedly until a ranking falls out of the answers.

demos.shows: Two items to compare with pick keys and reason field

gaps: Cannot see the full ranking after casting judgments
No demo of proposing new items
Does not show multiple topics at once
blurb: Which matters more? Rank by comparison.

name: Paging
what: One configurable page, six building blocks, twelve ready-made shapes — a demo machine that swaps its middle based on configuration words.

demos.shows: Twelve ready-made pages with working configurations
The stage building block and how it works

gaps: Does not show all seven configuration words at once on front page
Limited explanation of Make before opening it
blurb: Configure pages with six words. See them live.

stage.should_cap: The realm is an app, not a column; middle takes full remaining width after rail

name: Platform
what: A design lab for a community platform built entirely from this framework's own words — research, decisions, prototypes and one working demo.

demos.shows: One interactive topic page with points, subtopics and a real like button

gaps: Cannot see all nine research topics at once
Limited view of the full platform architecture
blurb: Topics as worlds. One working demo included.

name: Research
what: A live research program aggregating four topics in parallel — each topic's log streams live to a front page showing credence-rated claims.

demos.shows: One research topic with its own claim feed and latest theories

gaps: Front page does not show all claims from all topics
Cannot compare theories across topics easily
Raw feed is hidden by default
blurb: Four topics, streamed live, rated by confidence.

name: Review
what: What strangers said each /imagine/ page is about, and what it actually was meant to be — the gap between those two is the finding.

demos.shows: Deep analysis of the review process and design learnings

gaps: Does not show actual before screenshots except as described
Limited detail on why each fix worked
blurb: What strangers said. What it meant. The gap.
